prompt: Copper paints the fence bright yellow
title: Yellow Fence
irony: Copper paints the fence bright yellow for a perfect tomorrow, but the wet paint keeps everyone away today until messy handprints make it theirs.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light hits the old gray fence outside Copper and Jade's house on the street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants to help paint the fence yellow, clutching his brush while reciting paint facts to correct Copper.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares Jade to swipe one huge yellow stripe while Copper warns the wet paint must stay clean until tomorrow.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Everyone sings the yellow fence hook while brushes slap bright paint up and down the pickets.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green dabs tiny dots and measures each drip while Jade slops big yellow splashes that run and puddle.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Jade stamps both hands in wet yellow, Black adds wiggly toe prints, and Copper gasps at the spotty fence.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew sings the yellow fence hook again as drips dry in the bright morning sun.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Copper stares at the spotty yellow fence and sees his perfect tomorrow keeps today's fun away.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Copper chooses today's smudgy hands over tomorrow's perfect paint and asks Green to press a print.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Copper sings the turned line over the hook as every kid presses a yellow handprint in a row.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Everyone sings the hook outside Jade's house where the gray fence now glows yellow with handprints.
